points.quote: They sit next to the code in `src/vs/**/test/` folders (`browser/`, `node/`, `common/`, `electron-*`).
Run them with `scripts/test.sh` (`scripts\test.bat` on Windows), which uses Electron. Add `--grep` or `--run <file>` to narrow the run.
`npm run test-node` runs the Node-only suite with mocha. - `npm run test-browser` runs the suite in Playwright browsers.
The `vscode-api-tests` extension and other extension tests also run in this group.
These are automated UI tests in `test/smoke/`, built on the driver in `test/automation/`. - Run them with `npm run smoketest`
The runners are in `test/unit/`. ... `test/integration/` ... `test/smoke/` ... `test/sanity/` holds release sanity checks.
